# 📊 NBFC Daily Watch — Friday, October 30, 2026

*Friday, Oct 30, 2026 edition · News & Markets desk. Indian prices are Thursday's (29 Oct) close. MCX gold is this morning's 07:08 IST print, spot gold is the 07:01 IST quote, and Brent is Thursday's settlement. Regulatory headlines only; the deep dive is in the Rules report.*

## 🔴 URGENT / High Impact


**1. Small NBFCs have lost an estimated ₹300 cr to cyberattacks in two months, mostly through payment and disbursement APIs.**
- ET, cited by Moneycontrol on 29 Oct, reports about **150 complaints/FIRs**. Targets are mostly NBFCs with turnover of about ₹1,000 cr or less; one Delhi lender reportedly lost ₹7.5 cr and then ₹7.25 cr days later. The ₹300 cr is a sourced estimate, not an official figure. ([Moneycontrol](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/rs-300-crore-stolen-from-small-nbfcs-in-cyberattacks-officials-flag-jamtara-style-fraud-risk-14063062.html), [ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/ai-powered-cyberattacks-siphon-300-crore-from-small-nbfcs-in-two-months/articleshow/135278215.cms))
- CERT-In's 9 Oct advisory describes attackers stealing gateway and partner-bank credentials, then calling disbursement APIs from whitelisted infrastructure to skip KYC, sanction and limit checks. Its fixes are credential rotation, MFA, maker-checker and payout limits. ([CERT-In advisory summary](https://www.compliedai.com/updates/cert-in/ciad-2026-0046-threat-actors-exploiting-payment-and-disbursement-apis-fo-cabo4h))
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** Muthoot Fincorp is much larger than the targeted NBFCs, but it disburses gold loans digitally across a large branch network, which routes substantial payout traffic through bank APIs. As a Middle Layer NBFC it falls under RBI's IT governance directions.

**2. Rate-hike talk got louder. US inflation came in hot, gold fell and PNB Housing is raising lending rates.**
- US PCE prices rose **0.5%** in September. CME FedWatch now prices about an **83% chance of a December Fed hike**. Spot gold fell about 1% on Thursday. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/29/gold-slips-as-markets-assess-fed-signals-await-us-inflation-data.html))
- Spot gold was **$4,006.44 (−0.79%)** at 07:01 IST today, and MCX gold was **₹1,42,351/10g (−0.17%)** at 07:08 IST. ([exa.ai XAUUSD](https://exa.ai/library/markets/commodity/gold?currency=USD), [Makro](https://makro.live/mcx-gold-silver-price))
- PNB Housing will raise lending rates across tenors from **1 Nov**. CEO Ajai Shukla said a 25 bp increase hasn't slowed business and that a 75–100 bp rise in FY27 is unlikely. ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/no-business-impact-from-rate-hike-100-bps-rise-unlikely-in-fy27-ajai-shukla/article71641156.ece))
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** Lenders are passing higher costs to borrowers before the RBI moves. Gold at about $4,000 and below ₹1.43 lakh/10g on MCX keeps loan-to-value headroom tight on gold loans written near the peak, including at Muthoot Fincorp.

**3. Equitas SFB's MD & CEO P N Vasudevan resigned over a "perceived conflict of interest". The stock fell 20%.**
- His daughter co-promotes Unico Housing Finance, an RBI-licensed NBFC. He says there were no dealings beyond one repaid short-term deposit, and that the link was disclosed to the board and RBI. He stays on until a successor is in place. Equitas closed at **₹52.11 (−20%)** on NSE. ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/equitas-sfb-md-amp-ceo-p-n-vasudevan-resigns-citing-perception-of-conflict-of-interest-stock-down-20/article71640049.ece))
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** Investors priced a governance perception, not a breach, at 20% of market value. Muthoot Fincorp filed for a ₹3,000 cr IPO in August ([Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/business/indias-muthoot-fincorp-files-30-bln-rupee-ipo-2026-08-13/)); for a promoter-group company heading to listing, related-party and group-entity disclosures are a likely focus of investor questions.

## 🏢 Muthoot Fincorp in the market

- **Tranche I public NCD issue (open 23 Oct – 5 Nov 2026).** Bids stood at 1.67 times the ₹200 cr base issue at 17:00 on 29 Oct, up from 1.45× a day earlier: retail 1.42×, HNI 2.32×, non-institutional 1.10×, institutional 0.00×. The issue is ₹200 cr base plus ₹300 cr green shoe, allotted first come, first served, and closes 5 Nov. ([Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/))
- **Subsidiary.** Muthoot Microfin, Muthoot Fincorp's listed microfinance subsidiary, holds its Q2 board meeting on 5 Nov. ([StockFin](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/MUTHOOTMF/2026-10-23/board-meeting))

## 📈 Market & Stock Summary

- **Thursday 29 Oct close:** Sensex **74,151.04 (+905.01, +1.24%)**, Nifty **22,936.75 (+237.90, +1.05%)**. Both closed at the day's high. FMCG, PSU banks and realty led, while Auto slipped 0.24%. ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/sensex-nifty50-today-stock-market-highlights-29th-october-2026/article71635535.ece), [NSE index closes](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/indices/ind_close_all_29102026.csv))
- **Financials:** Nifty Financial Services **24,704.55 (+1.17%)**, Nifty Bank 54,909.65 (+1.18%). ([NSE index closes](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/indices/ind_close_all_29102026.csv))
- **Gold financiers led NBFC peers:** no company-specific trigger was reported, and the move came with the broad rally.
  - Manappuram Finance **₹302.10 (+4.62%)**
  - Muthoot Finance **₹2,497.10 (+4.36%)**
  - IIFL Finance **₹562.20 (+5.44%)**
  - Shriram Finance **₹841.10 (+1.03%)**
  - Bajaj Finance **₹938.90 (+2.36%)**
  - Cholamandalam **₹1,604.20 (+3.82%)**
  - LIC Housing Finance **₹514.00 (+0.75%)**
  - ([exa.ai NSE closes](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/MANAPPURAM?exchange=XNSE&date=2026-10-29&view=daily))
- **Flows:** FIIs were net sellers of **₹943.60 cr** and DIIs net buyers of **₹1,924.41 cr** (provisional). Equitas SFB and Hero MotoCorp (down more than 4% after its call) were among the day's notable losers. ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/fiis-turn-net-sellers-at-rs944-crore-as-sensex-jumps-905-points-20022757.htm))
- **Rupee & oil:** the rupee closed at **95.26/$, up 2 paise**. ([ThePrint/PTI](https://theprint.in/economy/rupee-gains-2-paise-to-close-at-95-26-against-us-dollar/3085407/)) Brent settled at **$114.88 (−0.38%)**. ([Morningstar/Dow Jones](https://www.morningstar.com/news/dow-jones/2026102914687/front-month-ice-brent-crude-fell-038-to-settle-at-11488-data-talk))
- **Coming up:** **LIC Housing Finance Q2 results today (30 Oct)**, with the earnings call on 2 Nov. The Street expects PAT of about ₹1,513 cr (+12%). ([Zee Business preview](https://www.zeebiz.com/companies/news-lic-housing-finance-q2-fy27-results-preview-profit-sales-margin-expectations-share-price-action-404764)) The Muthoot Microfin board meets on 5 Nov. The US election is on 3 Nov.

## 🏛️ RBI & Regulatory — Headlines Only

- **No new RBI notification for NBFCs since 27 Oct.** The 29 Oct press releases cover routine items. ([RBI press releases](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx))
  - The SGB 2019-20 Series VI premature-redemption price is **₹14,213 per unit**, based on IBJA 999 gold for 27–29 Oct. ([RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63884))
  - Section 35A directions on The Irinjalakuda Town Co-operative Bank, Kerala, were extended.
  - ECB data for August was released.
- **SEBI:** no new circular since the 27 Oct debenture-trustee timeline extension. The 28 Oct press release is an MoU with the Bank of England. ([SEBI circulars](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/home/HomeAction.do?doListing=yes&sid=1&ssid=7&smid=0))
- **IBBI:** no new circular. ([IBBI](https://ibbi.gov.in/en/legal-framework/circulars))
- **Due today:** the half-yearly CIMS upload for calamity-relief data (see Rules report).
- More detail on the Rules page.

## 💰 Financial Results & Performance

- **Kissht (OnEMI Technology), Q2 FY27:** PAT **₹125 cr (+100% YoY, +32% QoQ)**; AUM **₹9,317 cr (+68%)**; RoAAUM 5.78%. ([NSE filing](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ONEMI_29102026002048_Pressreleaseintimation.pdf), [ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/kissht-parent-q2-net-profit-doubles-to-rs-125-crore/articleshow/135272026.cms))
- **Equitas SFB, Q2 FY27:** PAT **₹218 cr** (about 9×), helped by provision reversals. Gross advances ₹50,669 cr (+30%). ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/equitas-sfb-md-amp-ceo-p-n-vasudevan-resigns-citing-perception-of-conflict-of-interest-stock-down-20/article71640049.ece))
- **Motilal Oswal**, consolidated PAT ₹1,081 cr (+198%), and **IndoStar Capital**, ₹13.2 cr (+31.8%), filed on 29 Oct. ([FlashFinance NBFC results](https://flashfinance.news/quarterly-results/sector/nbfc/))
- **PNB Housing follow-through:** the stock fell after results even with 11% sequential profit growth. Management targets a **40% non-housing share of retail** by FY27-end. ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/pnb-housing-finance-shares-fall-despite-11-sequential-profit-growth-asset-quality-improves-20022111.htm), [Moneycontrol](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/banks/pnb-housing-finance-to-expand-non-housing-loans-targets-40-of-retail-mix-share-14063486.html))

## ⚠️ Credit Rating Actions

- **Crisil upgraded Navi Finserv to A+/Stable from A/Stable** and its short-term rating to A1+. It also rated a new ₹500 cr NCD. AUM is ₹23,440 cr (June 2026), about 93% digital personal loans. The adjusted 90+ DPD fell to 3.2% from 6.9%, and Q1 funding cost was about 10.4%. Crisil says further upside depends on diversifying into secured lending. ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/business/finance/crisil-upgrades-navi-finserv-rating-assigns-rating-rs-500-crore-ncd-issue-20022547.htm))
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** A ₹500 cr A+-rated NCD from a retail lender competes for some of the same retail debt investors as AA-rated issuers such as Muthoot Fincorp.

## 🔄 Deals & M&A

- **Meesho's board approved up to ₹400 cr for Meesho Payments**, its lending service provider, and a new wholly owned financial-services subsidiary. Meesho says the subsidiary is meant to build in-house underwriting, own borrower relationships and capture the full lending margin. ([Elets BFSI](https://bfsi.eletsonline.com/meesho-payments-400-crore-infusion-new-financial-services-subsidiary-in-house-lending/))
- No significant NBFC M&A today.

## 💻 Digital & Fintech

- **Cyber losses at small NBFCs:** see Urgent #1.
- **Platforms moving from distribution to balance sheet:** Meesho (above) wants to move from LSP to owning credit risk, and PhonePe Lending is pushing data-led credit to small-town merchants. Thin-file small-town borrowers are Muthoot Fincorp's core gold-loan customer, and these platforms are now competing for them with data-led unsecured credit. ([Moneycontrol — PhonePe Lending](https://www.moneycontrol.com/technology/small-town-merchants-to-power-next-phase-of-credit-growth-says-phonepe-lending-ceo-hemant-gala-article-14062444.html))

## 📉 NPA & Asset Quality

- **Navi Finserv:** GNPA 1.38% (June 2026) against 2.5% in March 2025. ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/business/finance/crisil-upgrades-navi-finserv-rating-assigns-rating-rs-500-crore-ncd-issue-20022547.htm))
- **PNB Housing:** GNPA 0.91%, collection efficiency 99.3%. ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/pnb-housing-finance-shares-fall-despite-11-sequential-profit-growth-asset-quality-improves-20022111.htm))
- No new gold-loan asset-quality disclosures today.

## 👤 Personnel & Leadership

- **Equitas SFB:** P N Vasudevan resigned as MD & CEO (see Urgent #3). He told ETBFSI a successor could be identified in under a month and that there was no RBI nudge to quit. ([ETBFSI](https://bfsi.economictimes.indiatimes.com/articles/equitas-sfb-may-identify-new-ceo-sooner-than-a-month-vasudevan-says-no-rbi-nudge-to-quit/135320476), [Mint](https://www.livemint.com/industry/banking/equitas-md-quits-citing-overhang-from-daughters-business-shares-crash-11793281225794.html))

## 🏭 Sector Deep Dive — Friday: Auto finance & EV lending

**1. Two-wheeler demand is strong, EVs most of all.** Hero MotoCorp's Q2 FY27 call (28 Oct):
- Industry two-wheeler retail grew **27%** in Q2, with ICE +23% and EV +82%.
- Hero's EV wholesale rose **98%**, and Vida retail rose 74% to **66,000** units.
- Management said rural demand is "as good as, if not better than" urban, even with drought pockets.
- EV capacity doubled to **30,000/month**, aiming for 45,000 by Q4. The whole industry is supply-constrained.
- Hero raised prices by about **₹1,000/unit** from 1 Oct, and the stock fell more than 4% on margin commentary.
- ([Cofacto call summary](https://cofacto.ai/market-news/heromotoco-q2-fy27-earnings-call), [BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/hero-motocoro-not-cutting-down-on-investment-to-protect-margins-ceo-harshvardhan-chitale/article71639561.ece), [CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/fiis-turn-net-sellers-at-rs944-crore-as-sensex-jumps-905-points-20022757.htm))

**2. EV lenders are scaling and specialising.**
- Shriram Finance's EV disbursements are about **₹350 cr/month**, up from ₹30–40 cr at the start, with a ₹5,000 cr book target. Last Friday's edition cited ~₹300 cr. ([Business Standard, 25 Oct](https://www.business-standard.com/companies/people/shriram-finance-eyes-20-000-crore-gold-loan-book-bets-big-on-ev-growth-126102500447_1.html))
- Greaves Finance named Mukul Kanchan, formerly CFO at Plum and at Clix Capital before that, as ED & CEO to scale **ev.fin**, which finances e-two-wheelers at the point of sale in 86 cities. ([Greaves press release, 13 Oct](https://greavescotton.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/GCL_GFL_PRsd_removed.pdf))
- Astranova's Novafusion Capital (licence reported last week) is again in the news, targeting ₹5,000 cr of AUM in EV fleet and gig-driver lending. ([RDU Global, 29 Oct](https://rduglobal.live/article/2026/10/29/astranova-mobility-arm-wins-rbi-nbfc-licence-sets-rs-5-000-crore-aum-g-8691))

**3. Vehicle financiers keep growing in a rising-rate year.** TVS Credit's Q2 (reported 28 Oct): PAT ₹243 cr (+19%), AUM ₹33,818 cr (+22%), disbursements +31%. ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/tvs-credit-reports-19-growth-in-q2-pat-at-243-crore/article71632336.ece))

> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** Shriram runs vehicle finance and gold loans side by side and targets a ₹20,000 cr gold book, a competitive model for semi-urban and rural branches, including Muthoot Fincorp's. Strong rural two-wheeler demand supports borrowers' incomes but also commits more of their monthly income to fixed EMIs, so stress could show first as slower interest servicing on bullet gold loans.
- **Battery collateral:** EV lending prices battery and residual-value risk that no one has a long data history on. A gold loan carries none of that collateral uncertainty.

reports.content:
# 📋 NBFC Regulatory Daily Report
**Date:** Friday, 30 October 2026 (IST)

---

## 🔔 New Regulatory Updates Today

No significant developments today. RBI's notifications page still ends at the two UAPA circulars and the Delhi lead-bank circular of **27 Oct** (logged on 28 Oct). SEBI's latest circular is still the **27 Oct** debenture-trustee extension. There is no new RBI draft and nothing new from IBBI. Thursday's RBI press releases were routine; they are listed below as checked.

### What is in the market that is *not* an NBFC circular

| Item | What it actually is |
|------|---------------------|
| **RBI PR 2026-2027/1406 (29 Oct):** SGB 2019-20 Series VI premature-redemption price **₹14,213 per unit**, the simple average of IBJA 999 gold for 27, 28 and 29 Oct | Government bond redemption pricing. [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63884) |
| **RBI PR (29 Oct):** Section 35A directions on **The Irinjalakuda Town Co-operative Bank Ltd., Kerala** extended | Co-operative bank supervision. [RBI press releases](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx) |
| **RBI PRs (29 Oct):** ECB/FCCB/RDB data for August; FRB 2034 rate; ₹33,000 cr underwriting auction; money-market operations | Data and market operations. [RBI press releases](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx) |
| **₹300 cr cyber losses at small NBFCs** (ET, 29 Oct) and **CERT-In advisory CIAD-2026-0046 (9 Oct)** on abuse of payment and disbursement APIs | Press report plus a CERT-In advisory. **Not an RBI direction.** [Moneycontrol](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/rs-300-crore-stolen-from-small-nbfcs-in-cyberattacks-officials-flag-jamtara-style-fraud-risk-14063062.html), [CERT-In advisory summary](https://www.compliedai.com/updates/cert-in/ciad-2026-0046-threat-actors-exploiting-payment-and-disbursement-apis-fo-cabo4h) |
| **PNB Housing raising lending rates from 1 Nov** | Company pricing. Not regulation. [BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/no-business-impact-from-rate-hike-100-bps-rise-unlikely-in-fy27-ajai-shukla/article71641156.ece) |
| **SEBI press releases** | Latest still **28 Oct** (PR 66/2026, BoE MoU). [SEBI press releases](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/home/HomeAction.do?doListing=yes&sid=6&ssid=23&smid=0) |
| **RBI drafts** | Latest still **11 Sep** (KYC). The Interest Rate Directions draft (**12 Aug**) and the NBFC credit-facilities (revolving-credit) draft (**6 Aug**) are still pending. [Drafts](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/DraftNotificationsGuildelines.aspx) |
| **IBBI** | Latest circulars still **24 Sep**. [IBBI circulars](https://ibbi.gov.in/en/legal-framework/circulars) |

Primary sources checked this morning (IST):
- [RBI Notifications](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx): latest block 27 Oct.
- [RBI Press Releases](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx): latest 29 Oct (routine).
- [RBI Drafts](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/DraftNotificationsGuildelines.aspx): latest 11 Sep.
- [SEBI circulars](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/home/HomeAction.do?doListing=yes&sid=1&ssid=7&smid=0): latest 27 Oct. [SEBI press releases](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/home/HomeAction.do?doListing=yes&sid=6&ssid=23&smid=0): latest 28 Oct.
- [IBBI circulars](https://ibbi.gov.in/en/legal-framework/circulars): latest 24 Sep.

---

## ⏰ What did *not* move overnight

| Item | Status | Next date |
|------|--------|-----------|
| **Calamity relief, CIMS half-yearly upload** | NIL return required if no relief was given. | **Today, 30 Oct 2026** |
| **Q2 FY27 / LODR 52** | Books frozen at 30 Sep. | **14 Nov 2026** (15 days) |
| **Credit Risk-o-Meter** | Issued 7 Oct; goes live 45 days later. | **21 Nov 2026** (22 days) |
| Revolving-credit draft (6 Aug) | Still a draft. | Final expected around Nov 2026 |
| Interest Rate Directions draft (12 Aug) | Comments closed 11 Sep. | **1 Apr 2027** if finalised |
| Type I deregistration / NBFC-AA interoperability | Window open. | **31 Dec 2026** (62 days) |
| Recovery agents (RBC 3rd Amendment) | Certification, calling window, call recording. | **1 Jan 2027** (63 days) |
| **Internal Ombudsman quarterly return (Oct–Dec)** | Due by the 15th of the month after the quarter (para 16(2), IO Directions 2026). [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=13274&Mode=0) | **15 Jan 2027** (77 days) |

---

## 📅 Regulatory calendar

- **30 Oct 2026:** half-yearly CIMS upload on calamity relief (a NIL return is required if no relief was given).
- **14 Nov 2026:** last date for Q2 FY27 results of listed debt issuers under SEBI LODR Regulation 52.
- **21 Nov 2026:** SEBI Credit Risk-o-Meter disclosure applies to new debt offer documents.
- **31 Dec 2026:** Type I NBFC deregistration / NBFC-AA interoperability window closes.
- **1 Jan 2027:** recovery-agent requirements under the RBC Third Amendment take effect.
- **1 Apr 2027:** Interest Rate Directions take effect, if finalised.
- **15 Jan 2027:** Internal Ombudsman quarterly return for Oct–Dec due ([RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=13274&Mode=0)).
- **27 Apr 2027:** debenture trustees' deadline to ring-fence non-SEBI business.
- **30 Sep 2027:** last date to reverse unrealised pre-SNFA interest on legacy SNFA stock.

cards.title: Small NBFCs have lost an estimated ₹300 cr to cyberattacks in two months, mostly through payment and disbursement APIs.
cards.summary: ET, cited by Moneycontrol on 29 Oct, reports about 150 complaints/FIRs . Targets are mostly NBFCs with turnover of about ₹1,000 cr or less; one Delhi lender reportedly lost ₹7.5 cr and then ₹7.25 cr days later.
cards.impact: Muthoot Fincorp is much larger than the targeted NBFCs, but it disburses gold loans digitally across a large branch network, which routes substantial payout traffic through bank APIs. As a Middle Layer NBFC it falls under RBI's IT governance directions.

cards.title: Rate-hike talk got louder. US inflation came in hot, gold fell and PNB Housing is raising lending rates.
cards.summary: US PCE prices rose 0.5% in September. CME FedWatch now prices about an 83% chance of a December Fed hike .
cards.impact: Lenders are passing higher costs to borrowers before the RBI moves. Gold at about $4,000 and below ₹1.43 lakh/10g on MCX keeps loan-to-value headroom tight on gold loans written near the peak, including at Muthoot Fincorp.

cards.title: Equitas SFB's MD & CEO P N Vasudevan resigned over a "perceived conflict of interest". The stock fell 20%.
cards.summary: His daughter co-promotes Unico Housing Finance, an RBI-licensed NBFC. He says there were no dealings beyond one repaid short-term deposit, and that the link was disclosed to the board and RBI.
cards.impact: Investors priced a governance perception, not a breach, at 20% of market value. Muthoot Fincorp filed for a ₹3,000 cr IPO in August (Reuters); for a promoter-group company heading to listing, related-party and group-entity disclosures are a likely focus of investor questions.

cards.title: Tranche I public NCD issue (open 23 Oct – 5 Nov 2026).
cards.summary: Bids stood at 1.67 times the ₹200 cr base issue at 17:00 on 29 Oct, up from 1.45× a day earlier: retail 1.42×, HNI 2.32×, non-institutional 1.10×, institutional 0.00×. The issue is ₹200 cr base plus ₹300 cr green shoe, allotted first come, first served, and closes 5 Nov. (Chittorgarh)

cards.summary: the stock fell after results even with 11% sequential profit growth. Management targets a 40% non-housing share of retail by FY27-end.

cards.summary: and its short-term rating to A1+. It also rated a new ₹500 cr NCD.
cards.impact: A ₹500 cr A+-rated NCD from a retail lender competes for some of the same retail debt investors as AA-rated issuers such as Muthoot Fincorp.

cards.summary: its lending service provider, and a new wholly owned financial-services subsidiary. Meesho says the subsidiary is meant to build in-house underwriting, own borrower relationships and capture the full lending margin.

cards.summary: see Urgent 1.

cards.title: Platforms moving from distribution to balance sheet
cards.summary: Meesho (above) wants to move from LSP to owning credit risk, and PhonePe Lending is pushing data-led credit to small-town merchants. Thin-file small-town borrowers are Muthoot Fincorp's core gold-loan customer, and these platforms are now competing for them with data-led unsecured credit.

cards.section: Sector Deep Dive — Friday: Auto finance & EV lending
cards.title: Two-wheeler demand is strong, EVs most of all.
cards.summary: Hero MotoCorp's Q2 FY27 call (28 Oct): - Industry two-wheeler retail grew 27% in Q2, with ICE +23% and EV +82%. - Hero's EV wholesale rose 98% , and Vida retail rose 74% to 66,000 units. - Management said rural demand is "as good as, if not better than" urban, even with drought pockets. - EV capacity doubled to 30,000/month , aiming for 45,000 by Q4. The whole industry is supply-constrained. - Hero raised prices by about ₹1,000/unit from 1 Oct, and the stock fell more than…

cards.section: Sector Deep Dive — Friday: Auto finance & EV lending
cards.title: EV lenders are scaling and specialising.
cards.summary: Shriram Finance's EV disbursements are about ₹350 cr/month , up from ₹30–40 cr at the start, with a ₹5,000 cr book target. Last Friday's edition cited ~₹300 cr. (Business Standard, 25 Oct) - Greaves Finance named Mukul Kanchan, formerly CFO at Plum and at Clix Capital before that, as ED & CEO to scale ev.fin , which finances e-two-wheelers at the point of sale in 86 cities.

cards.section: Sector Deep Dive — Friday: Auto finance & EV lending
cards.title: Vehicle financiers keep growing in a rising-rate year.
cards.summary: TVS Credit's Q2 (reported 28 Oct): PAT ₹243 cr (+19%), AUM ₹33,818 cr (+22%), disbursements +31%. (BusinessLine) - Battery collateral: EV lending prices battery and residual-value risk that no one has a long data history on.
cards.impact: Shriram runs vehicle finance and gold loans side by side and targets a ₹20,000 cr gold book, a competitive model for semi-urban and rural branches, including Muthoot Fincorp's. Strong rural two-wheeler demand supports borrowers' incomes but also commits more of their monthly income to fixed EMIs, so stress could show first as slower interest servicing on bullet gold loans.
